# TLDRGraph Workflow Explorer

TLDRGraph inventories repository source files and computes a deterministic
`source_hash`. A missing, invalid, or stale catalog makes `tldrgraph init` or
`tldrgraph refresh` return `needs_feature_workflows`. The active coding agent delegates each
discovered feature to its own source-reading subagent, then writes final catalog
and workflow files directly. A second init validates repository-relative files
and line ranges and generates a standalone browser explorer.

Commands:

    tldrgraph init [PATH] [--json]
    tldrgraph refresh [PATH] [--json]
    tldrgraph ui [--path PATH] [--serve] [--port PORT] [--open|--no-open]
    tldrgraph install [--path PATH] [--all-agents]

Generated workflows use `generated`, `partial`, or `pending` status. Every
displayed step cites a current file, symbol, and source range. The browser can
read source through its local server or a user-granted project folder.
